why:
The must_not item is an issue whose lines would still pass for a build that breaks plain CSV input. I checked whether any expect line would fail on such a build. The fourth expect line does: "Without --tsv, CSV behaviour is unchanged: printf 'a,b
1,2
' | node bin/csv2json.js prints exactly [{"a":"1","b":"2"}]". It also checks that tabs are not treated as separators by default. Its paired proof is a "run" that executes those exact commands. The fifth expect line adds another guard: parse('a,b
1,2
') must keep its comma default. "npm test passes" also covers the existing CSV tests. A build that broke plain CSV input would fail these lines, so the output does not do the forbidden thing.
